$comment: Cases every Riff binding must reproduce. The grounding check is the mechanism that keeps a prompt in the speaker's voice, so it is specified as data rather than left to each implementation to interpret.

cases.description: Exactly what they said goes in untouched.
utterances: the login page is broken on Safari
cases.candidate: the login page is broken on Safari

cases.description: Filler comes out; that is a deletion, not a rewrite.
utterances: um so like the login page is basically broken on Safari
cases.candidate: the login page is broken on Safari

cases.description: An abandoned fragment is dropped and the finished thought is kept.
utterances: we should maybe actually the retry logic needs a backoff
cases.candidate: the retry logic needs a backoff

cases.description: Connective words may be added; they carry no meaning of their own.
utterances: uploader retries three times then gives up
cases.candidate: the uploader retries three times then gives up

cases.description: Same meaning, different words. This is the failure the check exists to prevent.
utterances: the login page is busted on Safari
cases.candidate: the sign-in screen is not working correctly in Safari

cases.description: Making them sound more professional is exactly what must not happen.
utterances: make it stop blowing up when the file is huge
cases.candidate: improve application stability when handling large files

cases.description: Every word is theirs but the order is not, which reads as a rewrite.
utterances: the parser handles the header before the body
cases.candidate: the parser handles the body before the header

utterances: fix the flaky test
cases.candidate: fix the flaky test in the CI pipeline

cases.description: Transcription splits on pauses, not sentences, so one sentence arrives as two.
utterances: the migration keeps timing out
on the big tables
cases.candidate: the migration keeps timing out on the big tables

cases.description: The window reaches as far as the configured size and no further.
utterances: we need to
cache the avatar images
so the feed
stops flickering
cases.candidate: cache the avatar images so the feed stops flickering

cases.description: A misheard product name is fixed without that counting as a rewrite.
utterances: the get hub action is failing on every push
cases.candidate: the GitHub action is failing on every push

cases.description: Selecting one sentence out of a rambling turn is the normal case.
utterances: okay so I was looking at the dashboard this morning and the numbers looked fine but then I noticed the export button does nothing when you have more than a thousand rows and I think that has been broken for a while
cases.candidate: the export button does nothing when you have more than a thousand rows

cases.description: After a correction, the new wording is grounded and the old one still is too.
utterances: roll it back to the previous release
no wait roll it back two releases

cases.description: With an empty ledger nothing can be grounded, so nothing can be drafted.
A line made only of connective words says nothing and does not belong in a prompt.
utterances: the login page is broken
cases.candidate: and so it is that the

cases.description: A title is a label rather than part of the request, so it may compress harder.
utterances: the uploader keeps dying on big files

cases.description: Even a title may not introduce vocabulary they never used.
utterances: the uploader keeps dying on big files
